component.title: AppShell
component.purpose: A responsive application frame with named navigation, header, skip-link, and scroll-safe main content.

states.description: The workspace exposes navigation, a title, and a named main region.
Long content stays inside the main region without forcing the shell wider than its viewport.

claims.statement: The shell exposes complementary navigation and a named main region.
Keyboard users can skip directly to the main region.
Navigation transforms into a horizontally scrollable compact rail below the responsive breakpoint while main content remains min-width-safe.
Shell transitions are disabled when the user requests reduced motion.
